quarterly_data.signal: First presentation (IMS 2026, published in The Lancet Oncology) of the Phase 3 EXCALIBER-RRMM MRD analysis: at a median follow-up of 15.7 months in 420 evaluable patients, ZENBEXUS (iberdomide) with daratumumab and dexamethasone (ZDd) achieved an MRD-negative complete response rate of 41.1% versus 20.7% for DVd (p<0.0001; odds ratio 2.75), an overall response rate of 88.9% versus 76.1%, and complete response or better of 45.9% versus 24.9%. Grade 3/4 neutropenia occurred in 84.3% of ZDd patients versus 11.3% with DVd (dose reduction of ZENBEXUS for neutropenia 13.2%, discontinuation 1.0%), grade 3/4 infections in 39.2% versus 21.6%; PFS evaluation in the confirmatory analysis cohort (n=800) was ongoing. CMO Cristian Massacesi: ZENBEXUS is the first therapy in multiple myeloma to demonstrate superiority on an MRD-negative complete response primary endpoint.
